meta.name: Lithic Choir Field Automaton
meta.description: A robust clockwork field rig crafted by the blind monastic archivists of Quill Hollow, designed to harmonize with bedrock as frozen acoustic music. Once placed, it applies a gentle dampening aura that halves nearby tool wear (reduces durability drain). It relies heavily on blocks/lithic_choir_chisel_ore_7d4c to function.
